creditsPioneersFs15: The very first pioneers of the Global Market idea back in Farming Simulator 15 — even though things were naturally still a bit rough in those early days, they got it running first and laid the original foundation.
creditsSpecialKevink: Brought GlobalMarket, its original companion client, and GlobalCompany to a phenomenal level in FS17 & FS19. Recognizing the FS15 roots in no way diminishes his outstanding work, without which this project would never have been possible!
creditsAiBody: Redeveloped from scratch in Rust + Tauri v2 with massive support from Antigravity. Nobody here claims to be a solo Rust programming god — this client combines passion for Farming Simulator, thorough team/Dedi testing, and modern AI engineering.
licensesModalIntro: GlobalMarket builds upon proven open-source libraries distributed under permissive licenses (MIT, Apache-2.0, ISC, CC0-1.0). Many thanks to all authors and maintainers!
